lines.t: As the days grow darker, and the hearts grow colder
I see now how my silence, my turning away
Has wounded many
Everything I have done, or failed to do
Affects the flock around me
So I take this moment to confess
Before the Lord
And before you all
I'm sorry for the times I walked in my own way
Chasing shadows of this world while you waited in pain
I'm sorry for the hours I spent in idle slumber
While the trumpet sounded and I closed my ears again
I'm sorry for the pride that built walls around my heart
Refusing to call on Yahushua not from the start
I'm sorry I love the traditions of men more than truth
And let deception cover the eyes of the youth
I was blind and now I see the blood upon my hands
The weight of my rebellion across these forsaken lands
You can put the blame on me
You can put the blame on me
You can put the blame on me
Say you can put the blame on me
I'll be the reason for your stumbling
The cause of your falling away
And you can put the blame on me
You can put the blame on me
I'm sorry for the days I spoke peace
Where there was none
Smiling in houses of lies
While the prophets were shunned
I'm sorry I ignored the cries of the oppressed and poor
While filling my belly and locking every door
I'm sorry for the moments I chose comfort over the cross
And let the fire of conviction grow cold and be lost
I'm sorry I hardened my neck against the Lord's rebuke
And dragged others down with me in this great pursuit
I was lost, yet now I kneel in the ashes of my sin
Crying out for mercy
Where the healing can begin
You can put the blame on me
You can put the blame on me
You can put the blame on me
You can put the blame on me
I bear the shame of this generation's fall
If it wakes one soul into the call
And you can put the blame on me
you can put the blame on me yet hear this now in the volume spoken from above
for i know the thoughts of your heart and the deceit they're in turn from your wicked ways
And I will heal your land
But if you refuse
The calamity comes by your own hand
So put the blame I gave you last
For my part in the night
But rise up now, repent
Step into the light
Yeah, who's sure
Wakes with arms open wide
You can put the blame on me
Let His mercy abide
You can put the blame on me
